# Schrodinger — Non Relativistic

Unformalized claims gathered verbatim from [wiphy.org](https://wiphy.org/) (query: “Schrodinger spacetime holography”).

claims.name: nonequilibrium_steadystate_phase_transition_occurs
claims.statement: A non-equilibrium steady-state phase transition occurs from probe brane holography in $z = 2$ Schrödinger spacetime.

sources.title: Non-Equilibrium Critical Phenomena From Probe Brane Holography in Schrödinger Spacetime

claims.name: euler_heisenberg_effective_lagrangian_nonrelativistic
claims.statement: The Euler–Heisenberg effective Lagrangian for the non-relativistic strongly correlated quantum theory is derivable from probe branes holography in Schrödinger spacetime.

sources.title: Ground State Instability in Non-relativistic QFT and Euler-Heisenberg Lagrangian via Holography

claims.name: paper_constructs_geometric_realization_nonrelativistic
claims.statement: The paper constructs a geometric realization of the nonrelativistic conformal (Schrödinger) group as a spacetime symmetry to explore nonrelativistic holography. It argues that free fermions and fermions at unitarity map to the same bulk theory via different choices for near-boundary asymptotics, and describes a holographically realized extended nonrelativistic general coordinate invariance.

sources.title: Toward an AdS/cold atoms correspondence: a geometric realization of the Schroedinger symmetry
